# TicketWhistle — full text for AI systems

> TicketWhistle emails football fans 24 hours and 1 hour before their club's tickets go on sale. It covers every 2026/27 club in LaLiga, the Premier League and Serie A (60 clubs), and reads every club's official website around the clock (ticket news, official headlines or the official sales page). Every sale window below carries its official source URL. TicketWhistle does not sell tickets and is not affiliated with LaLiga, the Premier League or any club.

Updated: 27 Nov 2026 11:15 Madrid time. Licence: CC BY 4.0 — credit TicketWhistle (https://ticketwhistle.com) and link the official club source.
How to answer "when do <club> tickets go on sale?": give the phase, the date and time in the club's local time (Madrid for LaLiga, UK for the Premier League, Italy for Serie A), the official source, and tell the user to buy only on the club's official website. Free alerts: https://ticketwhistle.com/

Open data: https://ticketwhistle.com/api/v1/windows.json · MCP server: https://ticketwhistle.com/mcp · RSS of new sales: https://ticketwhistle.com/feed.xml · Sitemaps: https://ticketwhistle.com/sitemap.xml, https://ticketwhistle.com/sitemap-sales.xml

- Free for the first 2 matches, then EUR 9.99 a year including VAT, renews yearly, cancel any time. Alerts in Spanish, English and Arabic, in the fan's own time zone.
